modeller_questions.question: Should a reference master's SOURCE SURROGATE id be carried onto the REF at all? 8 of the 29 columns are source-system surrogates (DIAGNOSIS_ID, DISEASE_ID x2, ICD_ID x2, PCS_ID x2, and the ICD-to-disease map id). Each REF is keyed on a business code (ICD Code / Procedure Code / Charge Head Code / Room Category Code), so these surrogates are not canonical keys. I proposed them as 'Source ... Identifier' attributes rather than dropping them, because dropping a column is not a mapping decision. The modeller may prefer to drop them.

REF_DISEASE_ICD is ONE reference ('Canonical disease/diagnosis reference keyed by ICD') but FOUR source masters feed it: DIAGNOSIS, DISEASE, ICD_DISEASE and ICD. Three of them carry an ICD code and one (BJAZ_HM_DISEASE_MASTER) does not. Confirm the four collapse into one REF, or split disease from ICD-diagnosis. This is a modeller decision; the map routes all four to the single existing REF.

SAT_PRODUCT_EXCLUSION_CATALOGUE declares child key 'Active Sequence Number', which is NOT one of its attributes. Stage 4 mapped BJAZ_HM_EXCLUSION_MASTER.EXCLUSION_ID onto that name as if it were a payload attribute. It is now an augmentation recording EXCLUSION_ID as the CHILD-KEY SOURCE. Confirm the child-key column naming for the build.

SAT_PARTY_ADDRESS_USAGE was targeted by 14 mapped rows and does not exist in data_7.js. All 14 were re-homed to SAT_COMMON_ADDRESS. If an address-USAGE satellite (address type/role per party) is actually intended, it is a real model gap worth raising separately - but nothing in this source needed it, because usage is already carried by the instance label.

anchor_key_recovery_required.scope: the 646 map rows left as declared_absence by Stage 6.5b
anchor_key_recovery_required.why_not_reanchor_gaps: A reanchor_gap is structural: the anchor does not exist, carries zero satellites, or is a REF_*. All 240 (view, satellite) pairs here have an anchor that EXISTS, carries satellites, and equals parent(satellite). Recording these as reanchor_gaps would conflate a COVERAGE/key gap with a MISSING-ANCHOR gap -- the conflation CLAUDE.md records as having cost a passing gate on an earlier run. reanchor_gaps is deliberately left empty and needs_reanchor stays 0.
